title: US Strategy: After The Inflationary Boom
gist: Gavekal says the US is in an AI- and energy-driven inflationary boom that favors tech and energy stocks and cash over bonds. With rising risk of either an energy-led inflationary bust or a rate/energy-induced deflationary bust, it recommends a more balanced portfolio adding TIPS and energy stocks alongside high-grade nominal bonds.

insights.claim: The US economy is currently in an inflationary boom driven by AI investment and rising energy prices.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Current regime rewards real assets and capex beneficiaries over duration.
insights.quote: For now, the US remains in an inflationary boom driven by AI investment and rising energy prices.

insights.claim: In the current US inflationary boom, tech and energy stocks are favored, and cash is preferred over bonds.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Stay overweight tech and energy equities and hold cash rather than bonds while the boom lasts.
insights.quote: Such an environment favors tech and energy stocks, and cash over bonds.

insights.claim: Gavekal warns that further energy supply disruption could push the US from an inflationary boom into a full-on inflationary bust.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: An energy shock could hurt both equities and bonds, rewarding inflation hedges.
insights.quote: further energy disruption triggers a full-on inflationary bust

insights.claim: Higher interest rates and energy prices could eventually tip the US economy into a deflationary bust.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: A deflationary bust would favor high-grade nominal bonds over cash and cyclicals.
insights.quote: higher interest rates and energy prices eventually tip the US economy into a deflationary bust

insights.claim: Because risks of both inflationary and deflationary busts are rising, Gavekal recommends shifting the US portfolio toward a more balanced mix that hedges against a macro regime change.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Diversify away from a pure boom positioning ahead of potential regime change.
insights.quote: calls for a more balanced portfolio

insights.claim: Gavekal advises adding inflation hedges such as TIPS and energy stocks alongside high-grade nominal bonds to protect against both inflationary and deflationary outcomes.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Barbell TIPS/energy against high-grade Treasuries to cover both bust scenarios.
insights.quote: adding inflation hedges such as TIPS and energy stocks alongside high-grade nominal bonds
